title: Cohomology diagram for a directed affine ring system
statement: Given a directed ring diagram with colimit cocone and compatible maps of its spectra to a scheme T, and a sheaf G on the etale site of T, there exist a cohomology diagram H and a cocone B with explicit pullback comparison isomorphisms and cocone-leg equations as in Tag 09YQ. The complete quantified Lean signature, including all coherence equations, is recorded verbatim in lean.statement.

source.place: Canonical cohomology diagram and comparison maps; inverse-image and cohomology pullback functoriality

proof.text: Let D be R.op followed by Scheme.Spec, and let d be Scheme.Spec.mapCone c.op. Define H.obj i as H^p of the pullback of G along v i, and H.map f as the bundled cohomologyTriangleMap for D.map f.op and wv i j f. The identity and composition parts of cohomologyTriangleMap_laws, together with D.map_id and D.map_comp, give the functor laws.

Define B.pt as H^p of the pullback along vLimit, and its leg at i as the bundled triangle map for d.pi.app (op i) and wLimit i. The composition part of the triangle laws identifies H.map f followed by the leg at j with the triangle map along d.pi.app (op j) followed by D.map f.op. The cone equation d.w f.op identifies this composite with the leg at i, proving cocone naturality.

Choose identity isomorphisms for eH and eB. Unfold only the triangle map and use AddCommGrpCat.ofHom_comp and the identity composition laws to obtain exactly the two requested equations. The colimit property, directedness and nonemptiness are not mathematically used in this construction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_spec_ring_cohomology_diagram
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (v : ∀ i : I, Spec (R.obj i) ⟶ T)
    (wv : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), v j = Spec.map (R.map f) ≫ v i)
    (vLimit : Spec c.pt ⟶ T) (wLimit : ∀ i : I, vLimit = Spec.map (c.ι.app i) ≫ v i)
    (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v i)).obj G) p)),
    (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (cohomologyMap (Spec.map (R.map f))
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v i)).obj G) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (Spec.map (R.map f)) (v i)
            (v j) (wv i j f)).inv.app G) p) ≫ (eH j).inv) ∧
    ∃ (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅
      AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} vLimit).obj G) p)),
    (∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (cohomologyMap (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v i)).obj G) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) (v i)
            vLimit (wLimit i)).inv.app G) p))
